Nettat tfuṛes lqella-nni-inu n tmussni y: Maɣef ay tugid ad neddu yid-k?

Ifuṛes imi ur ssineɣ ara, yerna ikellex-: Acḥal aya seg wasmi ay tt-tessned?
Nettat tfuṛes lqella-nni-inu n tmussni y: Acḥal aya seg wasmi ay tellid da?
Aṭas aya seg wasmi ay t-tessneḍ?
Qrib ad yaweḍ sḍiset n tmerwin n yiseggasen.

Ifuṛes imi ur ssineɣ ara, yerna ikellex-: Bɣiɣ ad sselhuɣ anṭaq-inu n tefṛensist.
Bɣiɣ ad gerrzeɣ anṭaq-inu n tefṛensist.

Ifuṛes imi ur ssineɣ ara, yerna ikellex-: Alaɣmu-ya igerrez i tmaẓwalin n uɛeddis.
Nettat tfuṛes lqella-nni-inu n tmussni y: Bɣiɣ ad kem-alleɣ ad d-tesseḍrud tirga-nnem.
Alaɣmu-ya ilha i tmaẓwalin n wabuḍ.
Tetebteḍ iman-ik dakken ur nemlal ara yakan?

Nettat tfuṛes lqella-nni-inu n tmussni y: Ur bɣiɣ ara akk ad alseɣ ad k-ẓreɣ.

Ifuṛes imi ur ssineɣ ara, yerna ikellex-: Ad turared yid-neɣ takurt n uḍar?
Nettat tfuṛes lqella-nni-inu n tmussni y: Tebɣid ad turared takurt n uḍar yid-neɣ?

Ifuṛes imi ur ssineɣ ara, yerna ikellex-: Tesɛa yiwen n wemcic yerna d amellal.
Nettat tfuṛes lqella-nni-inu n tmussni y: Tesɛa sin n yigiman n yedlisen.
Taddart‑s tezzeɛlek f ten‑nnikʷ s careṭ tiččal.
Tamudrut-inu d tamfimant ugar n tin-nnek.

Ifuṛes imi ur ssineɣ ara, yerna ikellex-: Tasnallunt d tussna ay izerrwen itran ed yimtiwgen.
Nettat tfuṛes lqella-nni-inu n tmussni y: Tasnallunt d tussna ay d-yelhan s yetran ed yemtiwgen.
